g.text: A seed already collected returns CACHED —
the cheapest possible answer, and it tells you
the host is already in another case.
hostile target, no passive mode, no proxy?
Fetching a hostile host from your own IP
tells the operator they are under investigation.
still cold? Wayback snapshot, then urlscan stored DOM
A cold seed never ends on silence: if every path fails,
keyless RDAP WHOIS · Wayback CDX timeline
own JS/CSS bundles, source maps, SPA routes
FOFA · urlscan · Censys · Shodan · WhoisXML reverse
Every absent key is DECLARED. A keyless run
says what it could not query, so "nothing found"
